title: Install the modpack
description: Pick a client and the components. The manager takes a snapshot first and never touches other mods without your confirmation.
profileLoaded: The selection is loaded from the profile

source.bundled: The packages ship with the manager
source.release: Version {version} is downloaded from the server; every package is checked against its sha256
source.unavailable: No packages: the server is unreachable and the manager ships none

otherModsDescription: Mods by other authors stay in place. Tick what you want removed: a snapshot is taken first.
otherModsEmpty: No other mods in this client
snapshotForced: A snapshot is required when other mods are removed
confirmRemoveDescription: Exactly the ticked files and folders are removed. The snapshot brings them back on the Backups page.
noCatalog: The component catalogue is not loaded: the server is unreachable and the manager ships none
